insight: Built by Editage parent Cactus Communications on 21+ years of academic-editing data; crossed 3M users in Nov 2025, tripling in 18 months.
name: Paperpal
tagline: AI academic writing assistant that takes researchers from draft to journal submission.
description: An academic writing assistant from Cactus Communications with discipline-aware language editing, paraphrasing, and translation tuned to scholarly prose. Pairs a research finder over 250M+ articles and citations in 10,000+ styles with pre-submission checks for plagiarism, AI-generated text, and 30+ technical requirements. Works on the web and inside Microsoft Word, Google Docs, and Overleaf.

modelSupport.notes: Proprietary in-house models trained on scholarly text; no model choice or BYO key.

edge: Unlike general-purpose checkers, it is tuned for scholarly prose — discipline-aware edits, citations in 10,000+ styles, and journal submission checks.
pros: Discipline-aware editing tuned to scholarly prose
Works in Word, Google Docs, and Overleaf
Backed by Editage's 20+ years of academic editing
cons: Free tier caps generative and plagiarism features
Overleaf support only via the Chrome extension
Proprietary models only — no LLM choice or BYO key
